description: Plans one Google profile post or photo from a real Showcase photo of the business, as Photos > Google posts does: kind media (a photo) or local_post (a written update), photo_id (from read showcase photos), and optionally photo_variant before or after, a location_id, and the person's own summary. Without a summary Sergio drafts one in the company's voice. Queuing is the approval: a caption that passes the guard is queued to publish on the business's own schedule, and the business's Google posts setting decides whether it goes out. A caption the guard refuses waits as a draft. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: plan_google_post
title: Plan a Google post or photo
